title: Blocking and bounded lock inspection
summary: pg_blocking_pids identifies lock blockers, including queue conflicts. Frequent calls can burden shared lock-manager state. Aggregate blocked-session counts separate measured blocking from generic canceled queries.
checks: Compare bounded blocked-session count with the canceled fixture read.
limitations: The collector caps candidates and retains no PIDs or query text.
